defs.d: (properly) An adult female of the species Bos taurus, especially one that has calved.
(formerly inexact but now common) Any member of the species Bos taurus regardless of sex or age, including bulls and calves.
Amusement, enjoyment or pleasure
Playful, often noisy, activity.
To tease, kid, poke fun at, make fun of.
defs.ex: Hey, don't get bent out of shape over it; I was just funning you.

defs.d: Enjoyable, amusing
defs.ex: He is such a fun person to be with.

defs.d: Whimsical, flamboyant
defs.ex: This year's fashion style is much more fun than recent seasons.

defs.d: In a way or manner that is real, not unreal.
(modal) Actually; in fact; in reality.
defs.ex: "He really is a true friend." / "Really? What makes you so sure?"

defs.d: Indicating surprise at, or requesting confirmation of, some new information; to express skepticism.
defs.ex: A: He won the Nobel Prize yesterday.

defs.d: (sarcastic, typically exaggerated question.) Indicating that what was just said was obvious and unnecessary; contrived incredulity
defs.ex: A: I've just been reading Shakespeare - he's one of the best authors like, ever!

defs.d: The day after the present day.
On the day after the present day.
At some point in the future; later on
defs.ex: If you don't get your life on track today, you're going to be very sorry tomorrow.

defs.d: The point where two converging lines meet; an angle, either external or internal.
defs.ex: The corners of the wire mesh were reinforced with little blobs of solder.

defs.d: An edge or extremity; the part farthest from the center; hence, any quarter or part, or the direction in which it lies.
defs.ex: Shining a light in the dark corners of the mind.  I took a trip out to his corner of town.

defs.d: To drive (someone or something) into a corner or other confined space.
defs.ex: The cat had cornered a cricket between the sofa and the television stand.

defs.d: To trap in a position of great difficulty or hopeless embarrassment.
defs.ex: The reporter cornered the politician by pointing out the hypocrisy of his position on mandatory sentencing, in light of the politician's own actions in court.

defs.d: An elevated location smaller than a mountain.
defs.ex: The park is sheltered from the wind by a hill to the east.

defs.d: A sloping road.
defs.ex: You need to pick up speed to get up the hill that's coming up.

defs.d: To form into a heap or mound.
To heap or draw earth around plants.
A piece of fabric attached to a boat and arranged such that it causes the wind to drive the boat along. The sail may be attached to the boat via a combination of mast, spars and ropes.
(nautical,uncountable) The concept of a sail or sails, as if a substance.
defs.ex: Take in sail: a storm is coming.

defs.d: An animal kept as a companion.
(by extension) Something kept as a companion, including inanimate objects. (pet rock, pet plant, etc.)
To stroke or fondle (an animal).
To stroke or fondle (another person) amorously.
Favourite; cherished; the focus of one's (usually positive) attention.
defs.ex: The professor seemed offended by the criticism of her pet theory.

defs.d: Kept or treated as a pet.
defs.ex: pet rock

defs.d: Act of requesting (with the adposition at in the presence of possessives, and on in their absence).
A formal message requesting something.
To ask for (something).
defs.ex: I have requested that the furniture be moved back to its original position.

defs.d: To ask (somebody) to do something.
defs.ex: She called me into her office and requested me to sit down.

defs.d: The act of achieving or performing; a successful performance; accomplishment
A great or heroic deed or feat; something accomplished by valor or boldness
To bring together as one.
defs.ex: I hope this song can unite people from all different cultures.

defs.d: To come together as one.
defs.ex: If we want to win, we will need to unite.

defs.d: Joined into a single entity.
Involving the joint activity of multiple agents.
Being in the centre.
Having or containing the centre of something.
The power to enforce rules or give orders.
defs.ex: I have the authority to penalise the staff in my department, but not the authority to sack them.

defs.d: (used in singular or plural form) Persons in command; specifically, government.
(modal) Truly; in fact; actually.
defs.ex: Indeed, he made several misplays.

defs.d: (degree, after the adjective modified) In fact.
defs.ex: As a soccer player, he is terrible indeed.

defs.d: Indicates emphatic agreement.
defs.ex: "I am a great runner." "Indeed!"

defs.d: With interrogative intonation (low-high) indicates serious doubt.
defs.ex: "I am a great runner." "Indeed?"

defs.d: A free (or low cost) trip for travel consultants, provided by a travel operator or airline as a means of promoting their service. A fam trip
Of, or relating to education.
defs.ex: A school is an educational establishment.

defs.d: Instructive, or helping to educate.
defs.ex: They were shown an educational film about VD.

defs.d: One of the substances present in a mixture, especially food.
To humiliate; to disrupt somebody's composure or comfort with acting publicly or freely; to disconcert; to abash
defs.ex: The crowd's laughter and jeers embarrassed him.

defs.d: To hinder from liberty of movement; to impede; to obstruct.
defs.ex: The motion was advanced in order to embarrass the progress of the bill.

defs.d: Having a feeling of shameful discomfort.
defs.ex: After returning from the pool, Aleshia felt significantly better, though she was still slightly embarrassed.

defs.d: Impeded; obstructed.
To be alive; to have life.
defs.ex: He's not expected to live for more than a few months.

defs.d: To have permanent residence somewhere, to inhabit, to reside.
defs.ex: I live at 2a Acacia Avenue.  He lives in LA, but he's staying here over the summer.

defs.d: The state of being alive.
(plural, with "the", a demonstrative, or a possessive) Those who are alive.
defs.ex: Respect for the dead does not preclude respect for the living.

defs.d: Having life.
In use or existing.
defs.ex: Hunanese is a living language.

defs.d: The overside or up-side of a flat object such as a table, or of a liquid.
The outside hull of a tangible object.
To provide something with a surface.
To apply a surface to something.
(often in the plural) Something which is done or is to be done; business of any kind, commercial, professional, or public.
defs.ex: a difficult affair to manage

defs.d: Any proceeding or action which it is wished to refer to or characterize vaguely.
defs.ex: an affair of honor, a duel;  an affair of love, an intrigue

defs.d: A distinguishing feature of a person or thing.
The integer part of a logarithm.
Being a distinguishing feature of a person or thing.
Situated close to, or even below, the ground or another normal reference plane; not high or lofty.
defs.ex: a low wall  a low shelf

defs.d: Of less than normal height; below the average or normal level from which elevation is measured.
defs.ex: a low bow

defs.d: Close to the ground.
Of a pitch, at a lower frequency.
To let descend by its own weight, as something suspended; to let down
defs.ex: lower a bucket into a well

defs.d: To pull down
defs.ex: to lower a flag

defs.d: Genuine; meaning what one says or does; heartfelt.
defs.ex: I believe he is sincere in his offer to help.

defs.d: Meant truly or earnestly.
defs.ex: She gave it a sincere, if misguided effort.

defs.d: An act of rubbing.
defs.ex: Give that lamp a good rub and see if any genies come out

defs.d: A difficulty or problem.
To move (one object) while maintaining contact with another object over some area, with pressure and friction.
defs.ex: I rubbed my hands together for warmth.

defs.d: To rub something against (a second thing).
defs.ex: I rubbed the glass with the cloth.
